title: Wi-Fi back after sleep
line: Keeps the Wi-Fi card awake enough to come back after sleep. Uses a little more battery asleep.
symptom: Wi-Fi is gone after sleep until a restart: the Intel card drops into D3cold and doesn't come back.
why: Intel Claws (MSI firmware with an Intel Wi-Fi card): the card drops into D3cold during sleep and doesn't come back.
risk_note: One udev rule. The Wi-Fi card uses a little more power while the Claw sleeps.

changes.detail: Stops Intel network cards on MS-1T* boards from entering D3cold.
Set to 0 at once; the old value is saved.

undo: Deletes the rule and writes the saved value back.

probe.what: Looks for the same rule from the system itself (any udev rule that isn't GameCove's and does the same), or the value already being right without GameCove.

watch.note: The SteamOS report this workaround comes from: closing it usually names the fixed build.
iwlwifi PCIe resume handling: a kernel fix would make the rule unnecessary.
